_note: Premium gap D_t = P_HL,t - P_X,t in bps (8-hour equivalent). P_HL,t: Hyperliquid's fundingHistory premium of the record stamped t (its average over [t-1h, t)). P_X,t: mean close of exchange X's one-minute premium-index klines opening in [t-1h, t); an hour enters only when all 60 minutes are present. Spans under the common rule: hours stamped 2023-12-11 23:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00 UTC, settlements 2023-12-12 00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00. A record belongs to the period its premium accrued in (stamp minus one hour), so 2023 and 2023Q4 start 2023-12-11 22:00. Band [-4, +6] bps with its edges, where the rule pays the floor; floors compared as decimals. Decomposition: a = Hyperliquid hourly in band, b = shifted by minus G, c = averaged over the exchanges' 8-hour blocks with the exchange's weights (hour h of the block 3600h + 1830; equal weights for Bybit blocks before 2024-03-07 16:00 UTC, as Bybit settled), e = c shifted, d = exchange settlements at the floor; f, g, h = exchange hourly + G, hourly, 8-hour + G (G = the quarter's median hourly gap). a - d is split over location, averaging and dispersion by the Shapley value over the eight corners; 'range' gives each factor's smallest and largest effect over the six orders; 'path' is the order location, averaging, dispersion (a to b to e to d), whose steps add up; 'contrasts' are single comparisons (a - b, h - d, a - c, e - d) that do not add up. Phase of a quarter, from the exchange's median hourly premium m: 'below' if m <= -4 bps, 'inside_nonpositive' if -4 < m <= 0, 'positive' if m > 0; the below-band quarters are also split into 2024Q3-2025Q4 and 2026. median_ci: 95% percentile intervals of the monthly and quarterly medians of D_t, moving-block bootstrap with 168-hour blocks and 2,000 replicates (block_sensitivity: the same with 24- and 72-hour blocks, from the same seed; coverage_change_vs_24h: the periods whose coverage of zero differs from the 24-hour blocks; December 2023 and 2023Q4 are partial and are listed apart: full_months_covering_zero, partial_months_covering_zero and the same for quarters). checks.usdc_pricing: daily mean gap on the daily mean ln(USDC/USDT) (Binance spot, bps); Hyperliquid's contracts are USDT-denominated and USDC-margined without conversion, so a slope of -1 would mean traders price the book in USDC, a slope of 0 that they price it in USDT as specified; slope_hac_se is a Newey-West standard error (20 days), within_quarter the slope of both series net of their quarter's mean. checks.oracle_wording_shift: mean daily gap over the 28 days from 2025-12-10 minus that over the 28 days to 2025-10-06 (the oracle documentation read 'spot prices' on the earlier date and 'spot mid prices' on the later), against every placement of the same windows in the sample; share_as_large counts placements whose change is at least as large in either direction, share_same_direction_as_large those at least as large in the observed direction. phase.by_band_position_by_year: the gap by the exchange's band position within each accrual year. hyperliquid_premium_ar1: OLS AR(1) with an intercept on Hyperliquid's hourly premium over each span, half-life ln 0.5 / ln phi in hours.
